actions.label: Capability Passport
actions.description: Inspect the evidence, score history, weaknesses, costs and strategies for any Buddy capability.

actions.label: Independent Evaluation
actions.description: Separate task execution from evaluation and reduce self-grading bias.

actions.label: Transfer Test
actions.description: Test whether a learned capability works on unseen or differently phrased problems.

actions.label: Mastery Gate
actions.description: Apply configurable evidence requirements before promoting a capability.

actions.label: Regression Protection
actions.description: Protect trusted capabilities with held-out regression tests.

actions.label: Remediation Center
actions.description: Route regressed or weak capabilities back into targeted learning and practice.
